string.text: Here you are, our professional hitwoman. I suppose those bastards will think twice before they dare visit our Swamp again. I hope. Here's your reward, by the way.

Mutants rarely stray close to our base. But our guys reported that the previous night some giant beast tore apart the whole team that manned the lookout tower to the north west. Four well-armed people just smeared all over the perimeter. Those weren't dogs for sure. I know you're a tough woman, so maybe you could visit the place and get rid of that nasty fucker?
Hey, great job, girl! I hope this reward's good enough for you. That and the stories people'll tell.
Great, you are a good huntress after all! I have payment for you.
Awesome, girl! Here, let me throw some money at you.
Even better! You came through for me once again! Here, let me throw some money at you.
You make me proud, girl! I wil make sure to do an amazing job with the tools you brought me. Take your reward, you deserve it.
Thank you, friend. You did your job well. Here is your payment.
